questions.stem_text: In Singer's view, the question of when it's wrong to painlessly kill an animal is one

questions.stem_text: Lukianoff and Haidt argue that the disinvitation of certain speakers

questions.stem_text: In a conditional syllogism, when the minor premise denies the antecedent

options.A: no valid conclusion can be drawn
options.B: the conclusion must affirm the antecedent
options.C: the conclusion must be a tautology
options.D: the conclusion must affirm the consequent
options.E: the conclusion must be an inverse statement

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - no valid conclusion can be drawn
